articles.title: Humanoid developer Neura acquires cleaning automation company Adlatus Robotics
articles.summary: Neura Robotics is expanding its physical AI ecosystem into another key application area. Neura Mobile Robots is acquiring 100 percent of the shares in Adlatus Robotics, an established provider of autonomous cleaning robotics.
